in_marathi.name: Sharvad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Sacred Ash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvad is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shraddha' which means 'faith, belief, trust'. The prefix 'Shar' in the name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which is the name of the God of Sacred Ash. Thus, the name Sharvad signifies one who has deep faith and devotion towards the God of Sacred Ash.
